parameters.query:
=WITH c AS (
  SELECT max(fetched_at) AS cutoff FROM articles
  WHERE sent = false AND category <> 'uncategorised'
)
SELECT a.url, a.source, a.title, a.category, c.cutoff::text AS cutoff
FROM articles a, c
WHERE a.category <> 'uncategorised' AND (
  (a.sent = false AND a.fetched_at <= c.cutoff)
  -- test runs also include the last 24h of already-sent articles, so there is always something to test with
  OR ({{ $('Test (send to me)').isExecuted ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }} AND a.fetched_at > now() - interval '24 hours')
)
ORDER BY a.category, a.fetched_at DESC;
